description:
Private, local-first mood and symptom tracker. No account, no cloud. Vibecheck is a private, local-first mood and symptom tracker designed for complete privacy, ease of use, and low friction. Features
  • 1-Tap Quick Logging: Log your mood in seconds with minimal friction
  • Symptom & Energy Tracking: Track focus, energy, sensory levels, and sleep
  • Dopamine Menu: Grounding exercises and gentle prompts for self-regulation
  • Calendar Heatmap & Insights: Spot patterns and understand your mental health over time
  • Custom Moods & Tags: Personalize your tracking experience
  • JSON Data Export & Import: Complete ownership of your data
  • 100% Offline: Operates completely on-device without internet access
Privacy No data ever leaves your device. No cloud sync, no user accounts, no analytics, no ads, no third-party tracking SDKs. Open Source Licensed under the MIT License. Source code available on GitHub.
